q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance mini_lift mini) exposes a size modifier: `mini` is a bound prefix rather than an adjective predicable of the lift, and the compound rule lists size among the incidental descriptions that should not fuse at all ("a dented pail" -> two atoms).

q2_gaps: the implicit subject of a purpose infinitive ("devised a mini-lift to allow ...") -- the purpose-infinitive rule fixes the connective head and clause order but says nothing about who fills the purpose event's subject role; the parse chose the artifact rather than the matrix subject

the object of "get on / off NP" -- whether a particle verb whose particle is also a preposition takes a thematic role (per the phrasal-verb rule) or the preposition-named oblique (per the prepositional-verb rule)
notes: get_on / get_off are kept whole with no genus and the purpose infinitive takes (To sk_devise_1 sk_allow_1) with no tense on the non-finite complement chain -- all correct. Coordinating the two boarding events as two Theme atoms on one allow event is a reasonable reading of the VP coordination.
